selectionBoundary: Top specimen means current durable market presence or unusually clear canonical mechanism reference; not a causal success ranking.
Official/current sources establish product/mechanic facts where available; coupling/dynamic statements remain desk decomposition hypotheses until direct play or stronger evidence.
No mechanism is promoted as successful merely because it appears in a successful game.

specimens.title: Counter-Strike 2
specimens.whyIncluded: current Steam #1 Most Played; durable competitive reference

edges.claim: Unknown enemy state makes information sharing strategically consequential.
Round economy turns equipment into inter-round commitment.
Short rounds bound failure and make tactical/economic mistakes comparable.
Different positions create distributed team knowledge.

dynamics: execution skill + information economy + inter-round resource economy
small action set gains depth from opponent uncertainty and team information distribution
failureModes: too much opacity turns inference into guessing

specimens.title: Dota 2
specimens.whyIncluded: current Steam #2 Most Played; canonical MOBA systems specimen

edges.claim: Hero kits create distinct responsibilities and power timings.
Role specialization makes team value interdependent.
Item/power timings change which objectives and fights are viable.
Map control changes access to farm, vision and objectives.

dynamics: role interdependence + power curves + objective timing
local actions accumulate into delayed team-level strategic consequence
failureModes: role identity can blur under system overload
coordination burden can exceed individual agency

specimens.title: Fortnite Battle Royale
specimens.whyIncluded: global battle-royale/live-platform reference; Zero Build isolates the BR core from building

edges.claim: Loot uncertainty changes tactical options.
Shrinking space forces eventual interaction.
One-life stakes make route and engagement timing consequential.
Building can create cover/height and change the combat state.

dynamics: uncertain resources + forced convergence + one-life consequence
Build versus Zero Build demonstrates one major mechanic can reshape combat topology
failureModes: loot variance can overwhelm skill attribution
convergence feels artificial if route info is poor
building can create extreme skill-floor separation

specimens.title: Minecraft

edges.claim: World manipulation yields reusable material.
Resources become tools/blocks.
Production feeds persistent world transformation.
Player actions remain visible and alter future affordances.
Meaning of construction is chosen by the player.

dynamics: tiny block manipulation grammar + persistent composition + self-authored goals
survival pressure and creative freedom reuse the same world grammar
failureModes: building without affordance can become decoration-only

specimens.title: Factorio

edges.claim: Extraction creates flows that must be routed.
Topology and throughput limits create constraints.
Shortages/queues expose redesign targets.
Solved manual work becomes reusable capacity.
Control systems let built processes react.

dynamics: solve manual work once, then move cognition upward to the next constraint
simple flow primitives compose into large dependency graphs
failureModes: automation without moving constraints degenerates into waiting

specimens.title: Slay the Spire

edges.claim: Players build from imperfect offers.
Earlier choices change later offer value.
Path choice trades health, rewards and future options.
Encounter variation tests robustness versus specialization.

dynamics: stable combat grammar + constrained acquisition + path dependence
randomness appears upstream as adaptation pressure
failureModes: run variance can overwhelm strategic learning

specimens.title: Balatro

edges.claim: Deck modification changes reachable scoring patterns.
Jokers/cards/vouchers alter how ordinary hands become score engines.
Imperfect offers force adaptation.
Multiplicative interactions create build identity and payoff.

dynamics: familiar base grammar + rule-breaking modifiers + multiplicative synergy
legible poker hands anchor extreme emergent builds
failureModes: unbounded scaling can make late choices irrelevant
opaque exceptions turn discovery into memorization

specimens.title: ELDEN RING
specimens.whyIncluded: award-winning durable action-RPG specimen; current Steam Top 100

edges.claim: Enemy animation exposes timing information.
Enemy commitment creates punish opportunities.
Offense/defense/mobility share constrained capacity.
Learning routes/enemies can substitute for raw stats.
Death adds stakes while retry preserves knowledge.

dynamics: attributable failure + retry + route freedom
player mastery and character progression are separate recovery channels
failureModes: hard gates without alternate routes collapse exploration

specimens.title: Baldur’s Gate 3

edges.claim: Class/background/origin can unlock different solution paths.
World systems broaden agency beyond dialogue.
Different actions leave later-readable state.
Companions/factions reinterpret earlier choices.
Chance is shaped by positioning/state.

dynamics: agency becomes credible when different mechanical routes produce later acknowledgement
role/build identity changes possibility space, not only output
failureModes: branch explosion can become content-cost trap

specimens.title: The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom

edges.claim: Ultrahand turns objects into composable machines/bridges/vehicles.
Fuse changes equipment affordances.
Ascend/Recall/constructions create nonstandard traversal solutions.
Consistent rules let players invent solutions beyond authored scripts.

dynamics: general-purpose verbs + consistent rules + many valid solutions
mechanics change geometry, equipment and time behavior rather than only numbers
failureModes: systemic freedom fails if only one scripted answer works
general verbs can trivialize authored challenges

specimens.title: Stardew Valley
specimens.whyIncluded: durable life/farm RPG; current Steam Top 100

edges.claim: Finite days force priority among personally chosen activities.
Prior setup yields future crops/animal/machine output.
Social goals compete with farm/economic goals for time.
Repeated activities unlock recipes/efficiencies that reshape routines.

dynamics: many low-pressure loops compete for one scarce daily schedule
persistent place + relationships + gradual competence support attachment

specimens.title: Hades
specimens.whyIncluded: canonical action roguelite + persistent narrative specimen

edges.claim: Each run offers different boon/build combinations.
Boons/weapons create run-specific identities.
Death returns quickly to another attempt.
Failure/success advances dialogue/story state.
Persistent unlocks soften repeated failure.

dynamics: failure is both mechanical reset and narrative progression
build adaptation is tied to story-return loop
failureModes: meta progression can mask weak learning
boon variance can dominate build agency

specimens.title: Sid Meier’s Civilization VI

edges.claim: District placement turns geography into long-term optimization.
Research unlocks new capabilities.
Geography/resources shape diplomacy/economy.
Victory intent revalues technologies/districts/diplomacy.
Early spatial commitments persist into later play.

dynamics: irreversible spatial commitments + multiple victory logics + long-horizon tech progression
same state is revalued by strategic intent
failureModes: late-game system count can overwhelm choice
one victory path can dominate globally

specimens.title: RimWorld
specimens.whyIncluded: durable colony/story-generator reference; current Steam Top 100

edges.claim: Storyteller selects incidents based on colony situation.
Social bonds propagate wounds/deaths/events into later state.
Needs/mood/environment change pawn behavior and risk.
Different colonists/world conditions create different priorities.
Accumulated structures, injuries and relationships become story material.

dynamics: simulation state is narrative substrate
director shapes pacing while local systems produce specific consequences
failureModes: detail without interaction becomes spreadsheet burden

specimens.title: The Sims 4
specimens.whyIncluded: canonical life-simulation/creative sandbox; current Steam Top 100

edges.claim: Created identity gives player-chosen role/fantasy.
Interactions accumulate into social states.
Homes persist as artifacts and simulation context.
Career/skill growth creates optional arcs.
Unexpected events generate stories around player intent.

dynamics: create people + create space + simulate consequences
player-authored context is acted on by the simulation
failureModes: content breadth can conceal weak base interaction

specimens.title: Into the Breach

edges.claim: Enemy intent is shown before player action.
Position manipulation redirects threats without only killing.
Civilian/grid protection creates multi-objective tradeoffs.
Random boards/enemies recontextualize deterministic verbs.
Failure restarts context while preserving player knowledge.

dynamics: near-perfect information + deterministic consequence + multi-objective spatial manipulation
depth comes from constrained interaction rather than hidden RNG
failureModes: telegraphing becomes rote if states lack variety

recurringMotifs.name: Stable grammar, changing context
recurringMotifs.claim: A small stable action grammar can support long-term depth when goals, state, topology, resources or modifiers repeatedly revalue the same actions.

recurringMotifs.name: Persistent consequence turns actions into authorship
recurringMotifs.claim: When actions persist and later systems acknowledge them, choices become material for future play rather than isolated transactions.

recurringMotifs.name: Failure must preserve information
recurringMotifs.claim: Retry loops are strongest when failure yields an attributable model update, route/build knowledge or strategic information.

recurringMotifs.name: Path dependence creates build identity
recurringMotifs.claim: Earlier choices should alter the value or availability of later choices; otherwise progression becomes a linear shopping list.

recurringMotifs.name: General-purpose mechanics outperform bespoke interactions when rules stay consistent
recurringMotifs.claim: A few composable, consistently simulated verbs can generate large solution/content spaces without enumerating every interaction.

recurringMotifs.name: Scarcity creates choice only when alternatives stay legible
recurringMotifs.claim: Time, information, life, inventory or currency scarcity creates strategy only when tradeoffs are understandable rather than merely deprivation.

recurringMotifs.name: Multiple timescales create durable loops
recurringMotifs.claim: Top specimens often couple second-to-second actions, session commitments and long-horizon progression/economy so one timescale changes another.

recurringMotifs.name: Randomness works best upstream of decisions
recurringMotifs.claim: Randomized offers, layouts and events create adaptation when players respond to them; opaque random outcome resolution weakens attribution.

recurringMotifs.name: Role depth requires non-substitutable responsibility
recurringMotifs.claim: Roles matter when players possess different capabilities, information or responsibilities that cannot be trivially replaced.

recurringMotifs.name: Systemic freedom still needs pressure
recurringMotifs.claim: Open possibility spaces gain direction from survival pressure, scarcity, self-authored goals, events or consequences; freedom alone is not a loop.

recurringMotifs.name: Readable causality is the foundation of mastery
recurringMotifs.claim: Intentional improvement requires system response to expose cause, constraint and consequence sufficiently well.

recurringMotifs.name: Meta systems should recontextualize core play
recurringMotifs.claim: Progression is strongest when it changes future possibility or strategy, not when it only increases scalar output.
